'''Osonu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[third Galactic War]], who specialized as a grappler by<ref name="Secrets" /> [[3626 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|6.3}}. Since Osonu appears in The Dark Descent, her fight can be placed in that same [[Standard year/Legends|year]] as well.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Stand and fight me!|Osonu|<ref name="Secrets" />}}
Osonu appears as a boss in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']] expansion. Osonu only appears in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] story, given that her role is replaced by [[Dogah]] in the Republic version of the story, who also functioned as a grappler.<ref name="Secrets" />

In the Imperial storyline, Osonu, together with Republic soldiers [[Meinar]] and [[Corrik]], fight [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]], [[Darth Krovos]], and [[Darth Rivix]], when they land at the [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] [[Jedi Enclave]] to investigate the whereabouts of [[Darth Malgus]]. Osonu and both her companions are killed by the Commander's group.<ref name="Secrets" />
